info.title: /IOTCONNECT™ File API
info.description:
File REST API contains information of file add, update, delete and get.

Headers

Needed Headers for all the API.

Authorization     Bearer + access_token (Generated From api/v1.1/auth/login API)
Content-Type    application/json

post.description: This API endpoint allows you to upload files on the cloud. You can upload different files like user profile, device image, firmware file etc. For that, you need to send ModuleType, defining the type of file. The fileRefGuid is a reference guid, saying a file belongs to which module. For example, for a user profile, it requires a user guid to define that to which user the file belongs.

412.description: Indicates that a condition set for this request is failed, and the request cannot be carried out.

401.description: Indicates that authentication is failed because of the token is invalid or expired or missing.

500.description: Indicates that the request could not be carried out because of some technical error on the server.

200.description: Indicates that the file uploaded successfully and returns file details.

409.description:
Indicates that the request could not be carried out because of one of the below or other conflicts on the server.
invalid logged user or company.

parameters.name: fileRefGuid
parameters.description:
